author: reek
body: Lattice probe, right direction (effect rows stage 0). A callee declares the sub-effect [Console.Write] (over-declared; its body is pure, which is always allowed). A caller declared [Console] calls it: Console.Write is covered by Console via the dotted prefix relation (effect-covered-by). Must compile today and under rows. Regression-tests CL 6509: find-dot must find the CCE dot, not ASCII 46, or the prefix relation is dead code and this rejects.
